policy: Exclude Philippine individual birth/death anniversaries; retain authentic government-designated national days or internationally instituted observances as review candidates. The draft exclusions do NOT delete archive records, runtime data or user state. No records are automatically human-certified.

Canada: #118 Wave20 draft; distinct canonical origin IDs only
Philippines: Original Gazette/Philippine laws for item-specific designation
NCCA calendar is an index, not self-sufficient evidence of official holiday
South Korea: MOIS statutory national holidays vs ministry government commemorations
No founding year inferred from listing
